# Recently Added

New resources accepted into [Awesome Codex CLI](README.md), recorded automatically from changes on main.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-recently-added.py. Newest entries first. -->

- 2026-10-15 — [Lockpaw](https://github.com/sorkila/lockpaw) - macOS menu bar app that covers the screen while Codex keeps running. `lockpaw install-hook codex` adds a notify entry and a PermissionRequest hook, so the locked screen glows when Codex finishes or waits for approval. ([GUI & Apps](README.md#gui--apps))
- 2026-10-15 — [Blave Agent](https://github.com/Blave-TW/blave-agent) - Open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows) that drives Codex CLI or Claude Code to write, backtest and run trading strategies. ([GUI & Apps](README.md#gui--apps))
- 2026-10-15 — [clausona](https://github.com/larcane97/clausona) - Switches between Codex CLI and Claude Code accounts with separate config homes, shares conversation history across accounts so `codex resume` continues a session another account started, and picks an account by 5-hour and weekly usage. macOS and Linux. ([Account Switchers & Proxies](README.md#account-switchers--proxies))
- 2026-10-15 — [Caprock](https://github.com/dspv/caprock) - Local dashboard that reads Codex CLI transcripts alongside Claude Code, OpenCode and Gemini CLI sessions: live activity, token cost per repository at API list prices, loop alerts, and searchable history. ([Usage & Monitoring](README.md#usage--monitoring))
- 2026-10-15 — [Threadlines](https://github.com/Threadlines/threadlines) - Open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that runs Codex CLI through `codex app-server`, with a live browser, terminal, and source control beside each thread, plus session resume after restarts and a phone client. ([GUI & Apps](README.md#gui--apps))
- 2026-10-15 — [Dory](https://github.com/tjqscott/dory) - Codex project-memory workflow using AGENTS.md directives, linked Markdown wiki pages, and a Python linter to preserve decisions and findings between sessions. ([Workflows & Knowledge Guides 🧠](README.md#workflows--knowledge-guides))
- 2026-10-15 — [coven](https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven) - Local-first daemon and CLI that runs Codex CLI, Claude Code, and other harnesses as PTY sessions inside explicit project-root boundaries, with SQLite-persisted history and a terminal session browser. ([Session Managers](README.md#session-managers))
